Source extraction already has this value under Apple Watch SE (3rd generation); override associates it with the drawing identity.

apple-watch-series-9-41mm.derivation: Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Layout, watchOS device screen dimensions table: row for Series 7, 8, and 9, 41mm explicitly lists width 352 and height 430 in pixels. The linked Series 9 support specification omits total pixel dimensions; the HIG supplies them directly.

apple-watch-ultra-2.derivation: Apple Watch Ultra 2 technical specifications, Size and Weight, explicitly lists 410 by 502 pixels. Source extraction already contains these pixels under Apple Watch Ultra2; override associates the record with the spaced drawing name.

apple-watch-1st-generation-38mm.derivation: Apple Developer Tech Talk Designing for Apple Watch Series 4, opening transcript: Apple describes the earlier 38mm and 42mm watches before the Series 4 display change, giving 272 by 340 pixels for 38mm. The first-generation technical specification identifies this model as a 38mm watch. This uses the explicit earlier-watch display dimensions, not a PPI calculation or an assumption that first generation means Series 1. The first-generation support specification itself omits pixel dimensions.
